import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        account=pl.col("@Account").str.strip_chars(),
        txn_date=pl.col("Date").str.to_date("%d/%m/%Y", strict=False),
        description=pl.col("Details").str.strip_chars(),
        amount=pl.col("Amount (NZD)")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        balance=pl.col("Balance").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        reference=pl.col("Reference").str.strip_chars(),
    )
